Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:10:1.english: There - In the Tabernacle, for the offerings were [for] the Most High.

Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:10:2.english: Here - at the dedication of the Temple, [the need] of a commoner [was] a banquet.

Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:10:3.hebrew: הכא נמי לעבדו - קרבנות, מיכל לא ליכלו:
Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:10:3.english: Here too, they should perform - [the] sacrifices; [as for] eating, they should not eat.

Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:11:1.hebrew: ביום השביעי - ומשמע לן יום ז' היינו שבת:
Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:11:1.english: On the seventh day - And it implies to us [that] the seventh day is Shabbat.

Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:11:2.hebrew: דלמא שביעי לקרבנות - שאם הקריב נשיא ששי בערב שבת, מקריב נשיא שביעי באחד בשבת. ומאי שביעי? שביעי לקרבן נשיא:
Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:11:2.english: Perhaps [it means] the seventh [day] of offerings - For if the sixth prince offered [his sacrifice] on Shabbat eve, the seventh prince offers [his] on Sunday. And what [is meant by] "seventh"? The seventh [day] of a prince's offering.

Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:11:3.hebrew: ביום עשתי עשר יום - האי "יום" יתירא משמע, מה יום רצוף שאין בו הפסק, אף כולהו י"א יום רצוף, דליכא הפסק בינתיים אפילו בשבת:
Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:11:3.english: On the day of the eleventh day - This superfluous [word] "day" implies: just as a day is continuous, having no interruption in it, so too all eleven days [are] continuous, such that there is no interruption in between, even on Shabbat.

Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:12:1.hebrew: דלמא ימים הראויין - למשתה, עביד משתה לאפוקי יום הכפורים:
Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:12:1.english: Perhaps days that are fit - [Fit] for feasting — he made a feast, excluding Yom Kippur.

Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:14:1.hebrew: גמר יום יום מהתם - מנשיאים דמשכן, דגמרינן מתרי קראי דהוו רצופים אפילו בשבת, אף משתה דחנוכת הבית הוו י"ד רצופים ואפילו [ביוה"כ]:
Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:14:1.english: It is derived [from] “day,” “day,” from there - From the princes of the Tabernacle, where we derive from two verses that [the days] were consecutive, even on Shabbat; so too [with] the feast of the dedication of the Temple, [they] were fourteen consecutive [days], and even on Yom Kippur.

Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:18:1.hebrew: כ"ד רננות - כתיבי בפרשה, בין רנה ותחנה ותפלה ובקשה:
Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:18:1.english: Twenty-four songs - They are written in the [scriptural] passage, [counted] between song, supplication, prayer, and petition.

Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:1:1.hebrew: מותרין לישא ערב הרגל - כלומר, מותר לכתחלה, ואע"ג דשבעת ימים של סעודה יהיו ברגל:
Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:1:1.english: Are permitted to marry on the eve of the Festival - That is to say, it is permitted from the outset, even though the seven days of [the wedding] feast will be during the Festival.

Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:20:1.english: The portion of vows - Tractate Nedarim.

Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:21:1.hebrew: ביום השמיני - של חג, היינו בעשרים ושתים:
Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:21:1.english: On the eighth day - of the festival; that is, on the twenty-second [of Tishrei].

Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:21:2.english: And it is written: “And on the twenty-third day” - Thus [we see] that on the twenty-second and on the twenty-third they took leave of him.

Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:23:1.english: Of form - That is to say, wise men.

Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:23:2.hebrew: פלס מעגל רגלך - כלומר, שקול מצות ועיין בהן איזו מצוה גדולה, ועשה הגדולה:
Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:23:2.english: Make level the path of your feet - That is to say, weigh the mitzvot and examine them [to see] which mitzva is greater, and perform the greater [one].

Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:23:3.hebrew: וכתיב ארח חיים פן תפלס - דמשמע, כל מצוה שתבא לידך עשה אותה, בין גדולה בין קטנה, ואל תניח קטנה מפני הגדולה:
Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:23:3.english: And it is written: “Lest you level out the path of life” - Which implies: any mitzva that comes to your hand, perform it, whether [it is] major or minor, and do not leave aside a minor [one] on account of the major [one].

Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:24:1.hebrew: מצוה שאפשר לעשותה ע"י אחרים - תפלס, פלס מעגל רגלך, שתעשה אתה הגדולה, וחבריך יעשו קטנה:
Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:24:1.english: A mitzva that can be done by others - You should weigh [the matter, as it states]: “Weigh the path of your feet,” so that you perform the greater [mitzva] and your companions perform [the] lesser [one].

Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:2:1.hebrew: עיקר שמחה - דנישואין חד יומא, ובשאר יומי לא חשיב מערב שמחה בשמחה:
Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:2:1.english: The primary joy - of marriage [is] one day, and on the other days it is not considered mixing [one] joy with [another] joy.

Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:3:1.english: The primary exertion - of the wedding [is] on the first day of the wedding.

Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:3:2.hebrew: לחד יומא לא משהו אינשי - כלומר, כיון שאינו יכול להתחיל אלא בערב הרגל, אין ממתינין עד הרגל, דדלמא מתרמי מלתא דלא מצי מתחיל בערב הרגל, ולא מתחיל כל הרגל:
Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:3:2.english: For one day people do not delay - That is to say, since he can only begin [the wedding] on the eve of the festival, they do not wait until the festival, lest something happen [such] that he cannot begin on the eve of the festival, and [thus] he will not begin [during] the entire festival.

Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:4:1.hebrew: ועביד ז' - יומי שמחה להכא ולהכא, לחנוכת הבית ולרגל:
Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:4:1.english: And made seven - days of rejoicing for this and for that, [i.e.,] for the dedication of the Temple and for the festival.

Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:5:1.hebrew: ודלמא מינטר לא נטרינן - נישואין עד הרגל, כי היכי דלא נטר שלמה, אבל אי מתרמי ליה עביד:
Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:5:1.english: And perhaps we do not delay - a marriage until the Festival, just as Solomon did not delay; but if it happens [to coincide], one may do [so].

Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:6:1.hebrew: אי הכי - דהיכא דאי איקרי ליה עביד, איבעי ליה לשיורי בבנין עד הרגל, כי היכי דליתרמי ליה חנוכת הבית ברגל:
Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:6:1.english: If so - that where it happens to occur for him, he may do [so], he should have left [part] of the building [unfinished] until the Festival, so that the dedication of the Temple would happen [to fall] on the Festival.

Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:6:2.hebrew: אמה כליא עורב - הגג כלה ומקצר למעלה עד כאמה, ומחפין אותו שם בברזל ובמסמרים כדי שלא ישבו העורבים עליו. זהו לא חשיב כבנין:
Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:6:2.english: A cubit [of] raven-deterrent - The roof finishes and narrows at the top to about a cubit, and they cover it there with iron and with nails so that the ravens will not sit upon it. This is not considered [part of] the building.

Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:7:1.hebrew: ודלמא אמה כליא עורב נמי צורך בנין הוא - להכי לא שייריה, אלא כל היכא דאיתרמי ליה לנישואין ברגל, לא ידעינן מנלן דלא עבדינן:
Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:7:1.english: And perhaps the cubit [structure] to ward off ravens is also a necessity of the building - For that reason he did not leave it [unfinished]; rather, wherever a marriage happens to occur for him on a Festival, we do not know from where [we derive] that we do not perform [it].

Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:7:2.english: Learn from it [that] these [are] separate - That he could not perform it together, even if it happened [to coincide].

Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:8:1.hebrew: לא עשו ישראל יום כפורים - לפי ששבעה ימים שלפני סוכות, כל יום עשו שמחה ומשתה, דכתיב: "ויעש שלמה בעת ההיא את החג שבעת ימים ושבעת ימים ארבעה עשר יום":
Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:8:1.english: Israel did not observe Yom Kippur - Because [during the] seven days before Sukkot, every day they held rejoicing and feasting, as it is written: "And Solomon held the feast at that time, seven days and seven days, fourteen days" [I Kings 8:65].

Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:9:1.english: And an individual’s offering - Of the princes.

Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:9:2.english: A prohibition [punishable by] stoning - Which is more severe than karet.

Rashi on Moed Katan 9a:9:3.english: And a communal offering - For what they were sacrificing during the days of the dedication of the Temple was a communal offering.

Tosafot on Moed Katan 9a:4:1.english: He should have waited until the festival - so that Israel would not be idle from their work so much.

Tosafot on Moed Katan 9a:6:1.hebrew: איבעי ליה לשיורי באמה כליא עורב - שלא היה צורך הבנין כ"כ, ואע"פ שהוא מהבנין כדי שלא יביאו הטומאה — אין זה צורך כל כך; וגם בשעת הבנין, בזמן שלא היה השכינה שורה בו, לא היה צורך:
Tosafot on Moed Katan 9a:6:1.english: He should have left out the cubit [called] kalya orev [raven-deterrent] - Because it was not so much a necessity of the building; and even though it is [part] of the building so that [the ravens] would not bring impurity [into the Temple], this is not such a [great] necessity. And furthermore, at the time of the building, when the Divine Presence was not [yet] dwelling in it, there was no need [for it].
